Global Sugar Prices Rise Due to Weather, Brazil Output, and Indian Imports

Global sugar prices have increased by 11.9%, according to the FAO. This rise is attributed to a combination of adverse weather conditions, lower sugar output from Brazil, and India's decision to allow duty-free imports. The Economic Times also noted that duty-free imports and other factors contributed to the increase in sugar prices.
